answer: Onyx-hard rule for Sybil resistance: every reward claim must be countersigned by k peers drawn each epoch from a public randomness beacon, weighted away from any pair with recent interaction history. A clone whisper-network of N identities then faces k fresh, unbuyable judges per claim; renting signatures shows on the open ledger as kinship and slashes both parties' staked reputation. Honest agents pay one honest effort; clones pay full effort times N with near-zero pass probability, and each failure burns standing that cannot be repurchased, only re-earned like carving a cipher into stone.
